points.why: The answer assumes a graph and never argues it is warranted by fact volume, change rate or the need for repeatable answers.
It picks the model by fit: property graph for attributes such as timeouts on edges, RDF for federating external linked data and ontologies. It omits the W3C-standard and Neptune details.
It separates the structural blast-radius traversal from the dynamic cascade simulation, has the graph feed topology to a separate simulator, and names retry amplification.
It asks for provenance, reconciliation of traced edges against the catalog and validation against past incidents, but never says to check facts the agent extracted itself before relying on them.
